title: All About Pendant Lights: Installing and Centering a 3-Pendant Kitchen Light (This Old House)
summary: This Old House's pendant-light installation guide walks through planning and executing a three-pendant setup above a kitchen peninsula. The segment covers determining structure and ceiling-box placement, upgrading a two-gang box to a three-gang with a dimmer, pulling and routing new wiring from the attic via a switch leg, labeling conductors, and wiring the three pendants with pigtails. It also shows centering the pendants using countertop measurements and a plumb-bob, drilling pilot holes, securing pancake boxes, sealing the top plate per code, and finally mounting the canopies. The video emphasizes practical wiring tasks (hot/neutral/ground identification, Romex handling, wire nuts) and retrofit mounting considerations for multiple fixtures on a single circuit.

Centering three pendants using countertop measurements
Pilot hole drilling for fixture boxes

sections.title: Planning and Attic Access
sections.description: Decides to hang three pendants and plans ceiling-box placement over the peninsula; notes open attic access to run wiring.

sections.title: Wiring Path and Switch Leg Prep
sections.description: Prepares wiring path from attic to wall boxes, demonstrates locating the second wire with a drilled access point, and labels wires before reconnecting at the switches.

sections.title: Box Retrofit and Rewiring
sections.description: Upgrades from a two-gang to a three-gang box, secures it to the stud, connects a dimmer, and uses pigtails to feed multiple pendants from a single circuit.

sections.title: Centering Pendants and Ceiling Transfer
sections.description: Centers three pendants by halving width and quartering length on the countertop, then transfers the layout to the ceiling with a plumb bob and drills pilot holes accordingly.

sections.title: Wiring, Firestop, and Canopy Mount
sections.description: Drives wires into pancake boxes, attaches ground conductors and connectors, seals the top plate per code, then runs switch legs between boxes and mounts the fixture canopies.
